description: Move one block on a page, as it is, to after or before another block named by its id (into a column, when that block is in one), or to the end of the page. Nothing else on the page changes.

after.description: The id of the block it goes after, in that block's page or column

before.description: The id of the block it goes before; with neither, it goes at the end of the page

id.description: The block's id, as read_page gives it

path.description: The page: "" for the home page, "_footer" for the footer

summary.description: What this change does, in a few words, for the history

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: move_block
title: Move a block
